newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-HK & China Gas upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-HK & China Gas upgraded.

text.p: SBC Warburg said it had upgraded its rating on Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd to buy from hold, due to its forecast above-average annual earnings growth rate of 19 percent up to 2000.

"HK Gas is gradually changing its strategy, broadening its focus to incorporate not just towngas generation and distribution but also local property development," analyst Peter Chu said in a recent research report.

The company is forecast to show earnings per share growth of 15 percent excluding its Hong Kong property earnings, and 19 percent when including earnings from its participation in three large property development projects, the report said.
Property contribution is forecast to represent 10 percent of total net profit in FY1999 and six percent in 2000, it said.
As at end of 1996, the company's capacity utilisation at its gas production plants was just 41 percent and no significant capital expenditure on new plant would be needed, the report said.
SBC Warburg forecasts 1997 net profit of HK$2.23 billion, a 13 percent increase over 1996, and HK$2.99 billion in 1998, an rise of 26 percent.
Hong Kong and China Gas shares closed HK$0.05 lower at HK$12.85 on Tuesday.
